Lord of the Rings, The - The Two Towers.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
Lord of the Rings, The - The Two Towers.summary: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers is an action and adventure game based off of the first two movies of the popular Lord of the Rings series, The Fellowship of the Ring and The Two Towers. Players battle their way through some of the key events of these films as Aragorn, Legolas, and Gimli.
